label: requireUser()
type: the sync-function helper that rejects a document update unless the acting user's identity exactly matches one of the specified user(s) - a finer-grained gate than any role or channel check. Its own reference page carries a caveat none of its three sibling require*() pages state: an argument derived from the document body ('doc') is attacker-controlled and must be checked against 'oldDoc' instead when comparing against prior state.
note: Object is sgw:user, via the requiresUser predicate promoted this round.
